title: Lena and the Vector
author: Sable Amberdale
blurb: Coral Thornbury, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
